views.label: Identity from OME
views.note: Two bulk OData calls name every server and carry its profile deployment status; namePattern is applied before any BMC is contacted.

views.label: Hardware from each iDRAC
views.note: The Redfish collector reads measured values; Oem.Dell NodeID is the Service Tag. A dead iDRAC still yields a stub.

views.label: Join and ingest
views.note: A content-identical server is only touch_seen'd; a changed one is written with a revision CAS (ADR-0044).

views.label: iDRAC reset
views.note: The only collector path that writes to a BMC: report-only by default, 12 h cooldown read from the audit trail (ADR-0050).

messages.label: GET Systems, Processors, Memory, EthernetInterfaces, Storage, Volumes, Drives
GET Chassis PSUs + PowerSupplyMetrics, Managers EthernetInterfaces, optional PCIe GPUs
failure → reachable=False stub; unreachable/rejected exit 0, mapping error COLLECTION_ERROR exit 3
messages.note: exit 1 when 5+ servers and over 20% failed (ADR-0062)

messages.label: per server as it arrives: OME identity + iDRAC hardware, joined on BMC host
stubs: not_an_idrac, unusable address first; dead hosts after the pass
classify + health + audit; changed: revision CAS, else touch_seen
all disks or all NICs UNKNOWN → GET JobService/Jobs
messages.note: queued per server, 5 workers, max 10 a run

messages.label: idle: power on if Off, POST Manager.Reset GracefulRestart
IDRAC_RESET audit event; 12 h cooldown read from it

cards.title: Why the split exists (ADR-0020)
items: OME's InventoryDetails gave ambiguous disk units, MediaType UNKNOWN for NVMe, no thread count
Only OME knows the name ocp4-nyc-prod-worker-03; only the iDRAC measures CapacityBytes and TotalThreads

cards.title: What live hardware corrected
items: 2026-09-08, iDRAC9: the Service Tag is Oem.Dell.DellSystem.NodeID, not SerialNumber; iDRAC7/8 unconfirmed
2026-09-10, production: TargetName held an OS hostname; the address is DeviceManagement[0].NetworkAddress

cards.title: Still open
items: The iDRAC GPU VRAM check (docs/field-test-checklist.md part 3) has not run on real hardware

One fleet-wide iDRAC account, every iDRAC tried every run: the auth guard was deleted 2026-09-12 and the operator accepts the lockout risk; a rejected login is an AUTH_REJECTED stub, exit 0 (ADR-0016, ADR-0037)

cards.title: iDRAC reset, the only BMC write (ADR-0050)
items: Only a reachable Dell with every disk or every NIC UNKNOWN, inside IngestService.ingest(), never ingest_one, --dry-run or the API pod
collectors.ome.idracReset.reportOnly is true by default; sending needs the Configure Manager privilege on the iDRAC account
An unfinished or unknown-state iDRAC job blocks it; a host that is Off is powered on first unless in maintenance

cards.title: Run bounds and exit codes
items: Schedule 0 */3 * * *, activeDeadlineSeconds 5400, 180 s per iDRAC, 3600 s for the pass (settings, Helm bmcHostBudgetSeconds / bmcRunBudgetSeconds)
Exit 0 only for NETWORK_UNREACHABLE or AUTH_REJECTED stubs; OME login or bulk failure exit 1; missing credentials exit 2 before any call
A profile's LastRunStatus 2070 is CRITICAL profile.deployment_failed, 2060 healthy, else UNKNOWN (ADR-0066)
